issues.title: BLU-001 privacy decisions and screen-frame policy

criteria.requirement: Observation requires active consent and stays off after restart or cancellation (modeled contract)

tests.name: default-off, restart, revoked consent and cancellation deny
missing permission denies

criteria.requirement: Private and unknown window classifications are denied (modeled contract)

tests.name: private and sensitive windows deny even with consent
unknown classification fails closed

criteria.requirement: Real screen capture, private windows, OS permissions and native focus-switch races verified
criteria.reason: A maintainer must record physical macOS Screen Recording/Accessibility permission and window-switch test evidence; a mocked Flutter test does not prove native privacy.

criteria.requirement: Threat model, data flow and absence of unapproved egress signed off
criteria.reason: Security/privacy review with named approver, commit SHA and evidence link is required; CI cannot attest a human review.

criteria.requirement: Canonical versioned JSON round-trip is stable

tests.name: canonical round-trip

criteria.requirement: Malformed enums, unknown schemas, unsafe fields and confidence values fail closed

tests.name: unknown version and extra payload fields fail closed
unknown enum, malformed json and invalid types rejected
confidence must be finite within zero to one

criteria.requirement: Serialized DTO excludes raw frames, paths and unbounded text

tests.name: no capture, IO, or lifecycle side effects in DTO

criteria.requirement: Schema compatibility and future migration policy reviewed
criteria.reason: Version 1 has no prior persisted schema to migrate; maintainer must approve explicit-version rejection and document when migration adapters become required.

criteria.requirement: Known Hebrew and English secrets/PII are refused; benign examples pass

tests.name: benign English and Hebrew project windows allow
recognised English/Hebrew PII and secrets blocked before egress

criteria.requirement: Unknown/private window metadata blocks watch processing and event buffers

tests.name: unknown window metadata blocks all frame and event work
sensitive English and Hebrew titles never enter event storage

criteria.requirement: Production watcher cannot accidentally invoke unverified vision inference

tests.name: production watch has no vision callback and no WatchVision
without a vision callback ticks keep running and nothing is sent

criteria.requirement: Atomic native window identity and background-pixel filtering proven before enabling screen-to-model inference
criteria.reason: Native crop identity can use cached focus information and may include background pixels; proactive production vision is intentionally OFF. Requires implementation and Mac verification.

criteria.requirement: Real macOS permission, focus-switch and leakage tests signed off
criteria.reason: Hardware TCC, OCR false negatives, focus races and sensitive-background tests need recorded device evidence and a reviewer.

issues.title: BLU-005 retention settings and delete-all UI

criteria.requirement: Scoped activity/cache purge protects unrelated stores in the isolated service

tests.name: delete activity and caches leaves protected stores alone
protected and unknown ids are refused, nothing cleared

criteria.requirement: Purge failures, duplicate IDs and concurrent requests are handled

tests.name: a failing store is reported by type only; the rest still run
a second purge while one runs is refused as busy, then works

criteria.requirement: Retention opt-in, expiry and scoped purge are implemented in Settings UI and wired to the real registry
criteria.reason: Merged PR #678 was service groundwork only; it did not connect a retention toggle or scoped purge to Settings and durable activity storage.

criteria.requirement: Readable data, journals and caches are deleted from verified encrypted activity storage
criteria.reason: BLU-004 (#557) encrypted ActivityStore and its physical deletion proof are not delivered by the purge service.

criteria.requirement: User data deletion semantics validated on real devices without deleting unrelated Routines
criteria.reason: A maintainer must confirm the UI and on-disk artifacts on supported systems after real storage integration.

criteria.requirement: Local Routine generator rejects malformed model JSON without executing it
criteria.reason: Merged PR #663 added a proposal document only; no local model-powered Routine generator or parser exists to test.

criteria.requirement: Generated Routine proposals support Hebrew and RTL review
criteria.reason: Hebrew/RTL draft-generation UI and validated model-output fixtures have not been implemented.

criteria.requirement: Runtime verifies local model selection and prohibits cloud fallback
criteria.reason: A documentation plan cannot prove Ollama/model deployment or absence of provider fallback; implement trusted local model boundary and tests.

criteria.requirement: Local-only inference and approval UX signed off
criteria.reason: Test model locality, provider routing, consent and UI on an isolated real host after implementation.

criteria.requirement: Existing Routine pack import properties are deterministic (supporting evidence, not Workflow DSL)

tests.name: the same seed always produces the same packs and results
every single-fault mutation is rejected with nothing changed

criteria.requirement: Workflow DSL valid/invalid/migration cases are generated and reproducible
criteria.reason: Workflow DSL (#567 / BLU-014) has not been implemented; pack-import property tests from PR #683 are not DSL tests.

criteria.requirement: Invalid Workflow DSL never reaches the executor
criteria.reason: No Workflow DSL validation-to-execution boundary exists to exercise.

criteria.requirement: Sanitized artifacts, supported platforms and failure behavior reviewed
criteria.reason: Maintainer must review DSL runner/platform behavior and CI artifacts after the DSL is implemented; real-device limitations remain manual.
